import sys,os,json,hashlib,resource,platform,importlib.metadata as m
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/task/source');sys.path.insert(0,'/task/source/benchmarks')
import torch,flagquantum
from qec_compatibility_matrix import _observe
from flagquantum.qec import Pauli,RotatedSurfaceCode,build_memory_circuit,PhenomenologicalNoise,compile_memory_sampler,DetectorErrorModel,PyMatchingDecoder
from flagquantum.qec.adapters.stim import memory_to_stim_text,stim_circuit_to_dem_text
from flagquantum.benchmarking.contract import runtime_metadata
assert flagquantum.__file__.startswith('/task/source/flagquantum/')
torch.set_num_threads(1);batch=int(sys.argv[1]);assert batch in (128,4096)
metadata=runtime_metadata(runner='qec_sampler_parity_paired',schema='flagquantum.qec_sampler_parity_paired.cpu_observations.v1',source_revision=os.environ['FQ_SOURCE_REVISION'],source_tree=os.environ['FQ_SOURCE_TREE'],device='cpu',distribution_semantics='single_process',local_world_size=1,node_count=1,rank_ownership={'0':'whole_workload'},scalability_claim_allowed=False,release_gate_allowed=False,non_release_evidence=True,precision='CPU int64 engine records, int8 detector/observable, bool logical predictions',torch_threads=torch.get_num_threads(),versions={n:m.version(n) for n in ['torch','stim','pymatching','numpy','scipy']},source_path=flagquantum.__file__,workload={'shots':65537,'batch_size':batch,'distance':9,'basis':'x','rounds':3,'seed':53,'noise':[.005,.007,.009]},methodology={'warmup':1,'measured_repeats':3,'independent_trials':False,'diagnostics_excluded_from_pipeline':True,'rss':'whole process including warmup/imports/diagnostics, not phase-specific'})
print(json.dumps(dict(kind='metadata',**metadata)),flush=True)
for index in range(4):
 row=_observe(distance=9,basis='x',entrance='native',shots=65537,batch_size=batch)
 row.update(kind='observation',index=index,warmup=index==0)
 print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
code=RotatedSurfaceCode(9);memory=build_memory_circuit(code,rounds=3,product=Pauli(x_qubits=code.data_qubits));noise=PhenomenologicalNoise(data_flip=.005,phase_flip=.007,measurement_flip=.009)
source=memory_to_stim_text(memory,noise=noise);dem_text=stim_circuit_to_dem_text(source);model=DetectorErrorModel.from_stim_text(dem_text);decoder=PyMatchingDecoder.from_detector_error_model(model.merge_duplicate_mechanisms())
hashes=[hashlib.sha256() for _ in range(3)];completed=events=failures=0
with compile_memory_sampler(memory,noise=noise,seed=53) as sampler:
 while completed<65537:
  sample=sampler.sample(shots=min(batch,65537-completed));predicted=decoder.decode_batch(sample.detectors)
  for h,tensor in zip(hashes,[sample.detectors,sample.observables,predicted]):h.update(tensor.numpy().tobytes())
  completed+=sample.shots;events+=int(sample.detectors.sum());failures+=int((predicted!=sample.observables).any(dim=1).sum())
print(json.dumps({'kind':'diagnostics','completed_shots':completed,'detector_events':events,'logical_failures':failures,'sha256':dict(source=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),dem=hashlib.sha256(dem_text.encode()).hexdigest(),detectors=hashes[0].hexdigest(),observables=hashes[1].hexdigest(),predictions=hashes[2].hexdigest()),'process_max_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss*1024}),flush=True)
reproduction.profile_source:
import sys,json,cProfile,pstats,hashlib,platform,importlib.metadata as m
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/task/source')
import torch,flagquantum
from flagquantum.qec import Pauli,RotatedSurfaceCode,build_memory_circuit,PhenomenologicalNoise,compile_memory_sampler
assert flagquantum.__file__.startswith('/task/source/flagquantum/')
torch.set_num_threads(1)
batch=int(sys.argv[1]);assert batch in (128,4096)
code=RotatedSurfaceCode(9);memory=build_memory_circuit(code,rounds=3,product=Pauli(x_qubits=code.data_qubits))
noise=PhenomenologicalNoise(data_flip=.005,phase_flip=.007,measurement_flip=.009)
profile=cProfile.Profile();hashes=[hashlib.sha256(),hashlib.sha256()];completed=0;calls=0
with compile_memory_sampler(memory,noise=noise,seed=53) as sampler:
 sampler.sample(shots=17)
 while completed<65537:
  requested=min(batch,65537-completed)
  sample=profile.runcall(sampler.sample,shots=requested)
  assert sample.shots==requested
  for digest,tensor in zip(hashes,[sample.detectors,sample.observables]):digest.update(tensor.numpy().tobytes())
  completed+=requested;calls+=1
profile.dump_stats('/task/out/batch'+str(batch)+'.prof')
stats=pstats.Stats(profile)
rows=[dict(file=key[0],line=key[1],function=key[2],primitive_calls=value[0],total_calls=value[1],self_seconds=value[2],cumulative_seconds=value[3]) for key,value in stats.stats.items()]
rows.sort(key=lambda item:item['cumulative_seconds'],reverse=True)
r={'scope':'sample-only cProfile attribution, not uninstrumented benchmark','source_revision':'0e61777d7e561098ae85d5c678765eb9e4ab50dc','batch_size':batch,'shots':completed,'sample_calls':calls,'warmup_shots_excluded':17,'seed':53,'threads':torch.get_num_threads(),'versions':{n:m.version(n) for n in ['torch','stim','pymatching']},'python':platform.python_version(),'hashes':[h.hexdigest() for h in hashes],'functions':rows}
print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
